constraints.covariance: Ledoit-Wolf shrinkage on the trailing 252 trading days, requiring at least 126 observations, using data only through each signal date.

disclosures: For each already-frozen alpha model, optimizer risk-aversion/turnover settings are selected only on 2020-2022 validation net Sharpe. Lower turnover breaks exact Sharpe ties. The primary alpha source is also declared using validation only. No 2023-2025 optimizer choice is retuned.
The 2023-2025 period has been inspected in earlier milestones and remains a frozen historical evaluation period rather than a pristine holdout.

If a configured turnover cap is mathematically infeasible because of the initial investment or a position-cap repair, it is relaxed only to the minimum feasible turnover and explicitly flagged in diagnostics.
